summary: Iteration 3 testing — email/password auth (signup + 6-digit verify), forgot/reset password, resend, login, Cloudinary signed upload, and full regression. All 38 backend pytest tests PASS (23 regression + 15 new iter-3). Frontend E2E verified via Playwright: signup → VerifyView → enter code (read from db.email_codes) → /dashboard; logout → login → /dashboard; forgot-link → email step → code+new-password → auto-logged-in /dashboard; video-upload-btn and save-profile-btn present on AthleteView. Gmail SMTP rejects credentials (BadCredentials 535-5.7.8) so signup returns email_sent:false but code is still stored in email_codes and the entire verify flow works — this matches the user-provided context note (credentials issue, not a code bug).

minor.issue: email_sent:false because GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD in /app/backend/.env is rejected by Google (535 BadCredentials). Per user note: regenerate app password — NOT a code bug. Flow works end-to-end since code is persisted in db.email_codes.
still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — pre-existing from iter 1/2.

action_items: User to regenerate Gmail app password and update GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD in /app/backend/.env so verification emails actually deliver (currently codes only readable via Mongo).
Optional (carry-over): migrate @app.on_event to FastAPI lifespan; split App.js (>800 LOC) into per-view files.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: review_request specified data-testid 'signup-email-input'/'signup-password-input', but actual App.js (lines 200-201) uses shared 'email-input'/'password-input' for both login and signup. This works because the same form fields are reused per active tab; tests pass with the shared testids. If a stricter naming convention is desired, rename for clarity in test docs.

auth_signup correctly stores pending_password_hash + pending_role in email_codes without creating a users row until verify — good (prevents zombie unverified users polluting the search/users collections).
auth_forgot returns ok:true even when user does not exist — proper email-enumeration mitigation.
upload/sign correctly scopes folder per user_id ('futconnect/{user_id}'), uses cloudinary.utils.api_sign_request (timestamp + folder signed), and returns required Cloudinary direct-upload params.
session_token cookie set with secure=True, samesite='none', httponly=True, max_age 7 days — appropriate for cross-site preview env.
bcrypt hash format is $2b$ via bcrypt.gensalt() — correct.
Pydantic EmailStr used on all auth payloads — invalid emails 422 before reaching DB.
code expiry honored on both /verify and /reset-password (10-minute window); expired test passes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (signup, verify, login, forgot/reset, athlete dashboard, video upload button present)

test_credentials: Email/password test users are created on-the-fly per test (TEST_<uuid>@example.com / secret123). Codes read directly from db.email_codes via mongosh. Existing cookie-based fixtures (atleta.test, coach.test) from /app/memory/test_credentials.md still valid for regression suite.
seed_data_creation: Each iter-3 test creates and cleans up its own email_codes/users rows. Demo athletes (Lucas Maré, Bia Armadora, Day Paralímpica, Rafa Veloz) still present from startup seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email delivery is broken (Gmail BadCredentials) — to verify signup/forgot codes, ALWAYS read from MongoDB: db.email_codes.findOne({email:'...', purpose:'verify'|'reset'}).code . Frontend signup uses shared 'email-input'/'password-input' testids, not 'signup-email-input'. After /verify or /reset-password, backend sets session_token cookie and frontend navigates to /dashboard automatically. All AI tests work within ~30s.
rca of the issue: N/A — no new bugs found. The email_sent:false signal is correctly propagated from the SMTP failure; backend continues to store codes in db.email_codes so the verify endpoint still functions end-to-end. Root cause of email delivery failure is invalid Gmail app password (env credential issue, not code).
